data_plan: 15-minute bars from the RD programme's venue data (crypto30 and forex_cross41 universes where 15-minute history is available); the run must state the exact panel, source and date range it used, and apply walk-forward folds per programme convention. The run is a separate, later step and is NOT part of the declaring PR.

evaluation_bar.costs: programme cost model AND a 2x-cost shadow run, both must pass; exits simulated under the harness convention (signal on close of bar i -> position managed from bar i+1, stop-before-target worst case)
evaluation_bar.judgement: OOS only; parameters are frozen by this declaration — nothing is selected in-sample
evaluation_bar.multiple_testing: Bonferroni against the programme trial floor at run time (floor >= 1980 trials as of 2026-11-15 and rising; the run must state the floor it used)

hypothesis: On a 15-minute chart, price revisiting the outer quartiles of the previous day's range with a wick-rejection (John Wick) trigger mean-reverts toward the box mid / opposite extreme often enough, and far enough, to clear the programme bar net of costs.
promotion_path: Passing the bar makes this a forward-test CANDIDATE only, under the Phase-3 forward protocol (>=100 trades AND >=8 weeks on demo). Nothing here authorises live trading.

rules.box: for day D: high = max high and low = min low of the previous present day's bars; mid = (high + low) / 2; a day with no previous day in the data, or a zero-height box, produces no signals
rules.frequency: at most ONE signal per day — the first qualifying extreme of the day; no re-entry the same day
rules.no_lookahead: the box uses only the previous day's bars; a signal uses only its own bar's OHLC
rules.parameters_fixed: ZONE_FRACTION=0.25, WICK_TO_BODY=2.0 — no other variants are authorised under this declaration; trying variants means new declarations and a higher trial count
rules.targets: T1 = box mid, T2 = opposite box extreme (box high for long, box low for short)
rules.timeframe: 15-minute bars; days are UTC calendar days
rules.trigger_long: a bar whose range intersects the bottom zone AND whose lower wick >= 2x its body AND which closes in the upper half of its own range; entry at that bar's close
rules.trigger_short: mirror: range intersects the top zone, upper wick >= 2x body, close in the lower half of the bar's range; entry at that bar's close
rules.zones: bottom zone = [low, low + 0.25 * height] (longs only); top zone = [high - 0.25 * height, high] (shorts only); the middle 50% of the box is a no-trade zone — a trigger pattern there produces NO signal

source: IG corpus item DWDUW26DYbZ (sweep crew-14): 'Box Theory' — each day draw a box from the previous day's high to low on a 15-minute chart, mark the middle, trade only at the extremes (buy at the bottom, sell at the top, on a 'John Wick candlestick' entry), avoid the middle where false signals cluster. The source's performance framing is an unverified claim and is treated as such: it bought this family a pre-declared test, nothing more.
status: DECLARED — not yet run. No backtest of this family has been executed anywhere at declaration time, and none is executed in the declaring PR.
